summary.text: Shomari Figures is the incumbent Democratic U.S. Representative for Alabama's 2nd Congressional District, elected in 2024. A Mobile native and University of Alabama law graduate, he worked in the Obama White House and Department of Justice, for Sen. Sherrod Brown, and as deputy chief of staff and counselor to Attorney General Merrick Garland under President Biden. He sits on the House Agriculture and Transportation and Infrastructure committees and is seeking a second term.

paragraphs.text: Figures was raised in Mobile, Alabama, and, according to his congressional biography, was educated there from kindergarten through law school. His father, Michael Figures, was a state senator and lawyer, and his mother, Vivian Figures, served on the Mobile City Council and is now a state senator.
He graduated from John L. LeFlore High School in Mobile and earned a bachelor's degree in criminal justice and history in 2006 and a J.D. in 2010, both from the University of Alabama.
He then clerked for a judge on the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Missouri and worked on President Obama's re-election campaign.

During the Obama administration, Figures served in the White House as Domestic Director of Presidential Personnel and then as White House Liaison at the Department of Justice, according to his congressional website. He later worked in the office of U.S. Senator Sherrod Brown (D-Ohio), and his congressional website also lists service as Counsel in Congress.
Figures worked on the Biden-Harris transition team and then returned to the Department of Justice as deputy chief of staff and counselor to Attorney General Merrick Garland.

Figures won the April 16, 2024 Democratic primary runoff over Anthony Daniels, with 61.1% of the vote, and the November 2024 general election over Republican Caroleene Dobson, 54.6% to 45.4%, in the redrawn 2nd District. For 2025-2026 he is assigned to the House Agriculture Committee and the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee.
He advanced from the 2026 Democratic primary without appearing on the ballot. According to his congressional website, he is married to Dr. Kalisha Dessources Figures, and they have four children.
